docPrivacyTitle.description: Privacy policy section title in documentation page

docPrivacyPara.message: Fullscreen Time stores your settings in Chrome Sync, so they may sync across devices signed in to the same Chrome profile. The extension does not send data to the developer: there is no developer server and no analytics. Video information is read only to display playback time while you are in fullscreen mode.
